name: audit-factions-harrow
description: Rules audit (factions): L1Z1X Harrow — during ground combat on tarmann (210), the active L1Z1X player's ground-combat prompt offers 'Harrow: BOMBARDMENT' (the engine answer finds that option; the original offered no bombardment after the invasion started). (TE: start_combat posts the coexist/engage choice first; L1Z1X engages.) audit-gaps-2: Harrow is used at the END of a round (TI4_RULES_FACTIONS), so both sides roll round 1 first. (gate35: no hits-assignment step — L1Z1X's round-1 roll may hit nothing, leaving no hits prompt; both sides roll the round either way.)
